title: The Counselor Gap: Why Students Need More *Support*
stat: The average US school counselor served 372 students in 2024-25, nearly 50% above ASCA's recommended 250.

spokes.heading: Some schools have none
spokes.body: Federal data for 2020-21 show about 1 in 6 public high schools had no school counselor, affecting about 4% of high school students.

spokes.heading: Private help has a price
spokes.body: IECA members reported typical comprehensive packages of $4,000 to $7,500 in 2022.

spokes.heading: Where D2Excel fits
spokes.body: D2Excel is building an open marketplace of counselors, with decision support that isn't gated behind who can afford it.

source: Sources: ASCA release, Feb 13 2026; K-12 Dive, Feb 23 2026; US Dept of Education OCR, 2020-21 CRDC First Look; IECA State of the Profession, Dec 2022
